objective: Preregister 24 candidates -- the exact rotation_cell cross-sectional momentum rotation mechanism already live on S1-S3, unedited, applied to a FACTOR-style ETF menu (MTUM/QUAL/USMV/VLUE/SIZE) and a narrow INDUSTRY ETF menu (SMH/XBI/KRE/ITB/IGV/XOP/XRT/IHI), grid = lookback {63,126,252} x top_n {1,2} x rebalance {monthly,weekly} -- for a batch screening lane (built separately) to test against K1 (own date-neutral Sharpe >= 80% of S3's in both the anchor and stress windows, positive CAGR at 20bp) or K2 (a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in both windows). No backtest is run in this round.

keep_rule.K1: date-neutral Sharpe (median over rebalance offsets) >= 0.80 * S3's date-neutral Sharpe in BOTH windows (anchor >=1.19, stress >=0.65), 10bp per side, positive CAGR at 20bp.
keep_rule.K2: 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in BOTH windows.
keep_rule.watch_recent: anchor-window date-neutral Sharpe >= 1.19 but stress window does not clear its bar -- forward-tracked only, not a keep.
keep_rule.strong_keep: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1's Sharpe in both windows is >= S3's own (1.49 anchor / 0.81 stress).
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: 24 candidates; report all regardless of outcome; DSR with n_trials=24 for any that pass.
keep_rule.g3_placebo: not applicable -- no discretionary pick or gate-timing parameter fit locally; the grid is a preregistered bounded sweep of the already-live rotation_cell engine, not a locally-fit rule.
